about_the_game:
This Myths and Muses Pack includes 11 furniture items, 21 clothing items, 4 Wigs, 1 mount, and 2 pets.

If you want to relive ancient myths, then this is the pack for you! The Myths and Muses Pack has 36 mythological themed outfits and furniture items available for you to customize your characters and decorate your homes, sheds, and farms.

Pack includes:
  • Myths and Muses Set: Myths and Muses Rug, Myths and Muses Wardrobe, Myths and Muses Bed, Myths and Muses End Table, Myths and Muses Table, Myths and Muses Painting, Myths and Muses Vase, Myths and Muses Statue, Myths and Muses Candelabra, Myths and Muses Chair, Myths and Muses Chaise
  • Messenger Outfit Set: Messenger Crown, Messenger Toga, Messenger Cape
  • Innocent Flower Outfit Set: Innocent Flower Wig, Innocent Flower Dress
  • Thundering Wisdom Outfit Set: Thundering Wisdom Wig, Thundering Wisdom Toga, Thundering Wisdom Sandals
  • Lover’s Kiss Outfit Set: Lover's Kiss Wig, Lover's Kiss Tiara, Lover's Kiss Dress
  • Web Woven Outfit Set: Web Woven Crown, Web Woven Dress, Web Woven Boots
  • Cursed Snake Outfit Set: Cursed Snake Wig, Cursed Snake Toga, Cursed Snake Boots
  • Lost King's Outfit Set: Lost King's Toga, Lost King's Sandals
  • Heroic Champion Outfit Set: Heroic Champion Chest, Heroic Champion Sandals
  • Royal Robes Outfit Set: Royal Robe Top, Royal Robe Pants
  • Warrior Spirit Outfit: Warrior Spirit Dress
  • Gladiator's Outfit: Gladiator's Chest
  • Ethereal Pegasus Mount Whistle
  • Kimmy, the Chimera Kitten Pet
  • Athena, the Owl Pet
